meta.description: Dixon-Coles rho per season and pooled (season-specific strengths, one gamma, one rho), LR test of rho = 0, pooled 11-season scoreline table with Pearson residuals, goal-histogram envelope, in-sample and held-out (2023-24 -> 2024-25) log-loss with and without the correction.

pooled_rho.how: joint MLE over 11 seasons (season-specific alpha, beta; one gamma; one rho; 431 params), 95% percentile CI from 1000 season-stratified match-resampling refits (seed 415); profile-likelihood CI [-0.0937, -0.0075]

pooled_lr_statistic.how: 2 x (loglik DC - loglik Poisson) for the pooled fit, 1 df; p = 0.0216; ci = central 95% range of chi2_1 under rho = 0 (not a CI of the statistic)

pooled_loglik_gain_nats.how: scoreline log-likelihood gain of the pooled DC fit over the pooled Poisson fit, total nats; ci = central 95% range of the gain under rho = 0 (chi2_1 / 2)

max_abs_pearson_residual_poisson.how: largest |(obs-exp)/sqrt(exp)| of the 17 pooled cells (0..3 x 0..3, 4+) under the pooled Poisson fit, cell 2-2; 4 of 17 cells exceed 2; ci = 95% range of that cell's residual in 2000 data sets simulated from the fit (seed 416, no refit); P(max |r| >= observed | model) = 0.009

max_abs_pearson_residual_dc.how: same under the pooled Dixon-Coles fit, cell 2-2; 4 of 17 cells exceed 2; ci from 2000 DC simulations (seed 417); P(max |r| >= observed | DC) = 0.008

observed_minus_expected_0_0_poisson.how: 0-0 count observed 263 minus expected 283.1 under the pooled Poisson fit (DC expects 305.3); ci = 95% range of obs - exp in 2000 simulated data sets (seed 416)

pearson_dispersion_pooled.how: sum of squared Pearson residuals of home and away goals / (2m - p), pooled Poisson fit; ci = 95% range under the Poisson model (chi2_7930/7930); per-season values 0.880..1.090 in dixon_coles_by_season.csv

goal_histogram_bins_outside_band.how: bins (0..6+, home and away, 14 total) where the observed count lies outside the 95% parametric-bootstrap band (2000 simulated data sets from the pooled Poisson fit, seed 418); ci field = possible range

insample_logloss_change_per_match.how: outcome (H/D/A) log-loss of the pooled DC fit minus the pooled Poisson fit over all 4180 matches, nats per match (negative = DC better); paired bootstrap of matches, 2000 resamples, seed 115, no refit

insample_logloss_change_total_nats.how: the per-match change times the number of matches (total nats over 11 seasons); same bootstrap

heldout_logloss_poisson.how: 2023-24 Poisson strengths frozen, promoted = mean of relegated, normalised 0..10 grid (reproduces numbers.json preliminary.log_loss.poisson); paired bootstrap of the 380 test matches, 2000 resamples, seed 115

heldout_logloss_dc.how: Dixon-Coles fitted jointly on 2023-24 only (rho = -0.0201), same freezing and promoted rule; same paired bootstrap

heldout_logloss_dc_minus_poisson.how: paired log-loss difference, DC fitted on 2023-24 minus Poisson, nats per match on 2024-25 (negative = DC better); 2000 paired resamples, seed 115

heldout_logloss_dc_prior_rho_minus_poiss.how: paired log-loss difference, Poisson 2023-24 strengths with rho pooled over 2015-16..2023-24 (rho = -0.0399) minus Poisson, nats per match on 2024-25 (negative = DC better); 2000 paired resamples, seed 115

heldout_logloss_dc_minus_pinnacle.how: paired difference DC (2023-24) minus Pinnacle pre-match (Fri/Tue collection) on 2024-25; same bootstrap

details.model: P(x, y) = tau(x, y; lam, mu, rho) Pois(x; lam) Pois(y; mu); tau = 1 - lam mu rho (0-0), 1 + lam rho (0-1), 1 + mu rho (1-0), 1 - rho (1-1), 1 otherwise; admissible max(-1/lam, -1/mu) <= rho <= min(1/(lam mu), 1)
details.fit: joint L-BFGS-B over Poisson log-parameters and rho with analytic gradient, warm-started at the Poisson MLE, rho box [-0.5, 0.5]
